scope: Nudge-style template/model resolution, placement optimization and perspective terrain preview. Original game/mod files and executable were not edited.

model_scale_fix.previous_bug: The initial preview applied only entity.scale.
model_scale_fix.vanilla_example: gfx/entities/buildings.gfx:144: building_rocket_site has scale=0.1; omitting it makes the geometry ten times too large.
model_scale_fix.materials: Embedded diffuse references, named/indexed meshsettings overrides, mesh-relative paths and unambiguous shared texture basenames. Duplicate basename conflicts are reported.

view.camera: Perspective, 45-degree vertical field of view, 50-degree inclination from vertical. Near/bottom terrain appears wider than far/top terrain.
view.terrain: Current in-memory heightmap, bilinear values multiplied by 0.1 and clamped to minimum 9.5; adaptive visible grid capped at 512 divisions per axis.
view.models: Same world coordinates, camera and depth buffer as terrain; record Y plus rotated/scaled mesh vertices.
view.interaction: CPU perspective projection and ray-heightfield intersection, cursor-anchored zoom/pan, model projected bounds for selection, coordinate popup and spring sliders retained.
view.fallback: Missing heightmap uses a flat plane; unavailable WebGL2 uses position markers and the flat editor.

performance.fixture: 2048x1024 synthetic map, 512 provinces, 64 states, 12 types, 4608 generated records. Same seeded workload before/after; algorithms also updated toward recovered Nudge neighborhood rules.
changes: One lazy map-run bounds index instead of full-map scans per province
Index existing records and state counts
Lazy model/texture loading and GPU instanced rendering
performance.thread_test: 4608 warm candidate calls: serial 0.0622 seconds, 8-worker thread pool 0.1139 seconds. Candidate results matched apart from generated IDs.
performance.decision: Keep generation on CPU with vectorized/cache reuse. Use GPU for terrain/models. Per-building threads were slower in the measured workload; GPU compute and process pools were not implemented.
performance.caveat: These are local editor measurements, not a live original-Nudge comparison or an end-to-end full-world timing.

verification.legacy_core_suite: 187/187 checks passed (PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 required for console checkmarks)
verification.browser_building_ui: Passed model pixel rendering, coordinate edits, undo/redo, save, new province inheritance/selection/generation, and state selection.
verification.browser_terrain_ui: Passed nonflat terrain, underground-model occlusion, above-ground visibility, cursor-anchored zoom and native factory/port/rocket model rendering.
verification.native_assets: 131 building .mesh files decoded and geometry attributes/indices checked; factory, port and rocket preview diffuse textures resolved.
verification.test_world: Disposable fixture files and synthetic in-memory terrain only.

limitations: Model previews use static geometry and diffuse lighting; original snow/specular shaders, animation, particles and all attachment behaviors are not reproduced.
Uses a fixed preview variant; game-state-dependent mesh variant selection is not reproduced.
No claim of exact live Nudge placement or camera parity. Floating-harbor parity caveats from the earlier coastal investigation still apply.

Province max greater than one follows the recovered expected-count routine (one missing placement per eligible province) and preserves additional existing records; fresh live-Nudge validation remains outstanding.
Reads loose game/mod assets; DLC archive mounting and every duplicate-name load-order edge case are not implemented.
